slides.texte_overlay:
quiet signs you were raised
to be strong

you fix things alone first

when something breaks, your first instinct is to try fixing it yourself. that habit slowly built a quiet confidence you probably don't even notice you have.

you stay calm for others

when everyone panics, you're the one who gets practical. being steady for other people is a strength most people only learn after years of hard moments.

you rarely complain

you'd rather solve a problem than talk about it for an hour. people deeply trust those who carry their weight quietly, even when nobody thanks them for it.

you keep learning

you keep teaching yourself things long after school: history, science, how things work. strong people stay curious because learning keeps a mind flexible under pressure.

slides.texte_overlay:
you don't need applause

you do the right thing even when nobody is watching. needing less approval is one of the clearest signs of real inner strength, and it lasts a lifetime.
